one_liner: Senior DOJ manager supervising a cybersecurity branch: leading information security programs, IT budgets, contractor oversight, continuity of operations and long-range IT strategy.
fit_summary: This GS-15 job needs a year at GS-14 level leading information security and IT programs. Daniel's resume shows office IT troubleshooting and emergency management, not IT security leadership, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public and the federal transition path, so federal status is not required; veterans' preference does not apply.

You must show 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-14: leading development of information security programs (guidance, procedures, tools) AND managing IT program execution and resources across multiple organizations, including financial management or cost-benefit analysis.
You must also meet the OPM 2210 IT Management basic qualification for GS-12 and above. No education substitution is allowed at GS-15.
Requires a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance, which means a TS/SCI-level background investigation.
All qualifications must be met by the closing date, 11/05/2026.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows office IT troubleshooting and emergency management, not the GS-14-level IT security leadership this job requires.

Search USAJOBS, Virginia VDEM and Prince William County for emergency management, continuity, program analyst, legislative or policy roles (GS-9 to GS-12 on the federal side), where his IEM and policy background is directly relevant.
resume_bullets: Brought emergency management best practices into a large travel company's emergency forms (Feb – Aug 2024).
Handled first-line IT troubleshooting with IT support as part of office manager duties at IEM (2019–2024).
interview_questions: Describe an information security program you built or improved. What guidance, procedures or tools did you create?
How have you justified an IT budget and ensured oversight and audit controls?
Tell us about holding a contractor accountable for performance under FAR or FITARA requirements.
How would you lead a branch through a Continuity of Operations activation?
watch_outs: The specialized experience requirement is senior and technical. Without documented IT security and program management leadership, you will likely be found ineligible.
An SCI clearance is required, and the background investigation can be lengthy.
This is a supervisory GS-15 role, so it may require a supervisory probationary period, and it involves commuting from Manassas to DC despite telework eligibility.
